Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

rows=['0000000000000','0000000000000','0000000000000','0000007770000','0000777070000','0000700070000','0000770070000','0000070077000','0000070007000','0000077777000','0000000000000']
# Shear each row left by its distance above the bottom-most occupied row.
occupied=[r for r,s in enumerate(rows) if '7' in s]
bottom=max(occupied)
out=[]
for r,s in enumerate(rows):
    shift=bottom-r
    row=['0']*len(s)
    for c,v in enumerate(s):
        if v=='7' and c-shift>=0:
            row[c-shift]='7'
    out.append(''.join(row))
print('\n'.join(out))
print('grid=', [[int(x) for x in row] for row in out])
